title: IP SLA: The Complete Beginner's Guide

scenes.narration: A link can be up, and still be terrible. One ping doesn't tell you much. I P S L A keeps measuring, on a schedule.

scenes.heading: The postal inspector
scenes.narration: An inspector sends test letters to see how good the service is. I P S L A sends fake traffic to measure delay, jitter and loss. By default it sends one every sixty seconds. Common probes are I C M P echo, U D P jitter and T C P connect. It only watches, so you link it to a track to change routes.

scenes.heading: Common mix-ups
scenes.narration: Three traps. It only monitors; it doesn't route. Only advanced probes need a responder. It sends fake test traffic.

items.wrong: IP SLA is a routing protocol

items.right: Only advanced ones like UDP jitter

scenes.cta: Try the Courseiva IP SLA lab
